buyers.name: NC Agricultural Development & Farmland Preservation Trust Fund (ADFP)

buyers.name: NC Land and Water Fund (NCLWF)

buyers.geo: Statewide NC including all Western NC footprint counties (Buncombe, Henderson, Rutherford, McDowell, Cleveland, Polk, Gaston, Lincoln, Burke, Transylvania, Mitchell).

buyers.name: South Carolina Conservation Bank

buyers.geo: Statewide SC including the entire Upstate footprint (Greenville, Spartanburg, Anderson, Pickens, Oconee, Cherokee, Union, Laurens).
